sn7.1:1.2: ekam samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane kalandaka-nivāpe || || 2.
sn7.1:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhāradvājagottabrāhmāṇassa Dhanañjānī nāma brāhmaṇī abhippasannā hoti buddhe ca dhamme ca saṅghe ca || || 3.
sn7.1:1.4: Atha kho Dhanañjānī brāhmaṇī bhāradvājagottassa brāhmaṇassa bhattam upasaṃharantī upakkamitvā tikkhattum udānam udānesi || ||
sn7.1:5.1: Evaṃ vutte bharadvājagotto brāhmaṇo Dhanañjānim etad avoca || || Evam
sn7.1:5.2: eva panāyam vasalī yasmiṃ vā tasmiṃ vā tassa muṇḍakassa samaṇassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati ||
sn7.1:5.3: idāni tyāhaṃ vasali tassa satthunovādam āropessāmī ti || || 5.
sn7.1:5.4: Na khvāhan-tam brāhmaṇa passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sedevakamanussāya yo tassa Bhagavato vādam āropeyya arahato sammāsambuddhassa ||
sn7.1:5.5: api ca tvaṃ brāhmaṇa gaccha || gantvā vijānissasī ti || || 6.
sn7.1:6.1: Atha kho bhāradvājagotto brāhmaṇo kupito anattamano yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn7.1:6.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 7.
sn7.1:6.3: Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho bhāradvājagotto brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ gāthaya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn7.1:9.1: Evaṃ vutte bhāradvājagotto brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn7.1:9.2: Abhikkantam bho Gotama abhikkantam bho Gotama || ||
sn7.1:9.3: Seyyathāpi bho Gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā akkujjeyya || paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya || mūḷhassa vā maggam ācikkheyya || andhakāre vā telapajjotam dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhinti || evam evaṃ bhotā Gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito || ||
sn7.1:9.4: Esāhaṃ bhagavantaṃ Gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi || dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca || ||
sn7.1:9.5: Labheyyāham bhoto Gotamassa santike pabbajjaṃ labheyyaṃ upasampadan ti || || 10.
sn7.1:10.1: Alattha kho bhāradvājagotto brāhmaṇo Bhagavato santike pabbajjam alattha upasampadaṃ || || 11.
sn7.1:10.2: Acirūpasampanno kho panāyasmā bhāradvājo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirass-eva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammad eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti || tad anuttaraṃ brahmacariya-pariyosānam diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi ||
sn7.1:10.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyam nāparam itthattāyā ti abbhaññāsi || || 12.
